subject: Is Nobara Kugisaki alive at the end of the story?

beats.title: Personality
beats.text: Realizing her time was likely at an end, Nobara took a moment to recall her past life in the village. She used to believe that crazy people like those villagers did nothing but step on other people's lives. However, after meeting all the wild and crazy sorcerers at Jujutsu High, Nobara changed her mind. During this exchange, Yuji watches Nobara with extreme worry and horror. In what could have been her last moments, Nobara smiled at Yuji and asked him to tell everyone that life wasn't so bad in the end.(Chapter 125, Episode 43)

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Currently, Nobara lays before Yuji, missing an eye, and likely dead. Losing to Choso, Sukuna's rampage, and Nanami's death had already taken a toll on Yuji's resolve. Having reached its limit a long time ago, Yuji's spirit breaks after Nobara is unable to answer as he desperately calls her name. Satisfied with himself, Mahito commends his own talents and believes he is a true cruse. He not only reinforces a punch with cursed energy but successfully unleashes Black Flash on Yuji.

beats.title: Bonus
beats.text: Character designer Tadashi Hiramatsu newly drawn three-sided back case Special Drama CD: "After the Promenade" 散歩道の後に Cast: Yuji Itadori, Megumi Fushiguro, Nobara Kugisaki Story: A holiday after the Kyoto school exchange meeting. Yuji, Megumi, and Nobara visit an amusement facility at the suggestion of Yuji, who wants to train in sports in preparation for next year's exchange meeting. Yuji plays all kinds of sports and has a great time. On the other hand, Nobara and Fushiguro have certain feelings for Yuji, who was "dead" for two months. Original "name" booklet "Anime Juju Sanpo" drawn by Gege Akutami Special leaflet Jacket postcard

beats.title: Summary
beats.text: With everything that Yuji's been through in Shibuya, his resolve finally gives way when Nobara appears to have perished. Mahito seizes the opportunity and adds physical decimation to the mental abuse. Just when all seems lost, Yuji's best friend arrives in time to reignite his spirit.

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Nobara is surprised to see Yuji and Mahito's real body acted as a blind spot to cover the switch so she wouldn't notice. Furthermore, her fight with the double made her to lower her guard against Mahito's hands. Mahito scores a direct hit on Nobara's face, potentially spelling the end for her. Yuji easily kills the double with a single shot and runs over to check on Nobara. Mahito waits to see if one touch will be enough to kill her since it wasn't enough to kill Nanami in their first encounter.

beats.title: Aftermath
beats.doc_title: Yuji Itadori & Nobara Kugisaki vs. Eso & Kechizu
beats.text: They're both happy to be alive but as a result tears were shed. Nobara agrees that this makes them accomplices.(Chapter 63, Episode 24)

beats.title: Personality
beats.text: Akari is a kind and caring person but is quite serious when it comes to working. However, she does have limits to her tolerance as shown when she grew rather short-tempered when the First Years didn't answer their phones when she tried calling them. However, she does tend to show concern for others, such as when she made a cover-up about Yasohachi Bridge so that the female civilian who had its curse wouldn't panic.(Chapter 55, Episode 22) She also didn't want Maki Zenin and Nobara Kugisaki to head off to break the veil right away, despite being accompanied by a Special Grade 1 Naobito.(Chapter 83, Episode 31) Even though Haruta was after her, she asked Kugisaki to not push herself. Once she was rescued from the former by Nanami even though she was badly injured, she made sure to ask him if Ijichi was still alive.(Chapter 99, Episode 36) She is also shown to be quite efficient at her job, during their investigation about the curse of Yasohachi Bridge, Nitta came up with the perfect alibi when a civilian she and the first years, were questioning started to suspect that they were talking about the curse.(Chapter 55, Episode 22) Even after she was kicked in the sternum and stabbed by Shigemo multiple times, she prioritized in crawling into a nearby escalator, while a weakened Nobara bought her time, which proved to be the right call, since Haruta would've held her hostage when Nanami arrived.(Chapter 100, Episode 36)

beats.title: Synopsis / Kyoto Goodwill Event Arc
beats.text: On the day of the event, Nobara prepares to head out to the event but wonders why the others are not packed. Panda explains to Nobara that the event is being held at the Tokyo college and not at Kyoto, which Nobara gets angry about this. After the Kyoto students and faculty shows up, Gojo arrives and reveals that Yuji is still alive, a fact that shocks Nobara. Nobara is angry at Yuji for keeping his revival a secret, forcing him to apologize.(Chapter 32, Episode 14) After the faculty explain how the event works, Nobara attends a pre-event meeting with the other Tokyo students and discuss what they will do during the event.(Chapter 33, Episode 14)(Episode 14)
